# Phillips

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolmaster  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044)</sub>
- **Titles:** Mr. Phillips  <sub>[v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013)</sub>; The master  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Teddy Phillips  <sub>[v1 c18 P6](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0006)</sub>

## Appearance

He spends much of his time curling his mustache while attending to Prissy Andrews.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)_

## Personality

He is sarcastic, strict, and prone to sudden fits of discipline, though his order in the schoolroom is generally regarded as poor. He shows open favoritism toward older students, particularly Prissy Andrews, while neglecting the younger children.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P57](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0057), [v1 c15 P65](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0065), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)_

## Traits

- Sarcastic  <sub>[v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 c15 P65](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0065), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)</sub>
- Favoritist  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>

## Abilities

- Teaching Latin, algebra, and the branches  <sub>[v1 c15 P27](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0027), [v1 c15 P31](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0031), [v1 c17 P37](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0037)</sub>
- Reciting dramatic speeches  <sub>[v1 c19 P39](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0039)</sub>

## Goals

- Prepare older students for the entrance examination into Queen's Academy  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>

## History

Mr. Phillips served as the schoolmaster of the Avonlea school, where he focused much of his attention on preparing older pupils for Queen's Academy. During his tenure, he frequently disciplined Anne Shirley, including making her stand before the blackboard for cracking her slate over Gilbert Blythe's head and forcing her to sit with Gilbert for being late. He also participated in local events, such as giving an address at the Debating Club concert. At the end of June, his term as teacher concluded and he departed from Avonlea, making an emotional farewell speech to his pupils.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091), [v1 c19 P39](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0039), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)_

## Background by volume

- Retained his position as Avonlea schoolmaster due to his uncle being a school trustee  <sub>[v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>

## Quotes

> Anne Shirley, what does this mean?  <sub>[v1 c15 P41](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0041)</sub>

> I am sorry to see a pupil of mine displaying such a temper and such a vindictive spirit. Anne, go and stand on the platform in front of the blackboard for the rest of the afternoon.  <sub>[v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044)</sub>

> Anne Shirley, since you seem to be so fond of the boys’ company we shall indulge your taste for it this afternoon. Take those flowers out of your hair and sit with Gilbert Blythe.  <sub>[v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061)</sub>

> The time has come for us to part.  <sub>[v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)</sub>

- Avonlea School — Teacher / Schoolmaster  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044)</sub>
- Avonlea Debating Club — Participant  <sub>[v1 c19 P39](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0039)</sub>

### Anne Shirley

### Gilbert Blythe

- Mentor of — Taught him in the fourth and fifth classes at Avonlea school  <sub>[v1 c15 P27](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0027), [v1 c17 P37](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0037)</sub>
